title: Minsky audit findings
description: Adversarial-audit output produced by one (model, persona) pair in one chain step. Findings cite verbatim evidence so converge.py can run a self-consistency check against the cited source files.

persona.description: The single-persona lens this output was produced under (matches a persona file name without extension).

findings.description: Zero or more findings. Empty array is a valid output if the reviewer found nothing to flag.

severity.description: Critical = blocks publishing/merge. High = should be fixed before next milestone. Medium = should be addressed. Low = nit.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path to the evidence file. Absolute paths and paths escaping the repo root are not valid for public audit records.

quoted_line.description: EXACT text of the cited line, verbatim, including all whitespace. converge.py's self-consistency check greps the cited file for this string; if absent the finding is marked verified=false.

suggestion.description: What the reviewer would do differently. Concrete and actionable.

agree.description: Overall reviewer judgment. 'partial' = agree IFF no critical/high findings remain.

reasoning.description: One paragraph: why agree/disagree/partial, from this persona's lens.
